records.primary_value: three-tier fidelity/escalation fabric: nspawn userspace -> QEMU/KVM separate-kernel -> exact physical target
concrete image/materialization and backend evidence ABI: pinned mkosi, nspawn fast lane, vmspawn/qemu peer VM backends, capability probes, ephemeral/persistent state modes

overlap: Both independently distinguish shared-kernel nspawn evidence from a full-VM separate-kernel evidence tier.
Both deny physical target credit to simulated lanes.
Both require measured comparison before promoting the multi-lane design to a build candidate.
Therefore they are one convergent E2 design signal, not two independent replications.
nonduplicate_delta_retained: Use mkosi as a pinned external image/lifecycle compiler candidate rather than importing an orchestration library into F2 authority.
Represent the Tier-B VMM as an explicit backend identity: QEMU_VM or VMSPAWN_VM; backend substitution requires a new receipt and cannot silently inherit prior fidelity.
Bind exact tool/backend versions or commits, target profile generation/digest, release candidate digest and host capability observations into a TwinBackendProfile.
Separate EPHEMERAL clean-slate scenarios from PERSISTENT_COPY update/rollback/reboot persistence scenarios.
KVM/VSOCK/TPM/EFI-NVRAM capability gaps are observed infrastructure/fidelity states; the harness must fail closed rather than auto-weaken host security settings.

fused_candidate.name: HRT_LAYERED_TWIN_WITH_TYPED_BACKEND_PROFILE/v0
fused_candidate.tier_a: NSPAWN_FAST materialized from pinned target-shaped image configuration
fused_candidate.tier_b: VM_BOOT with explicit QEMU_VM or VMSPAWN_VM backend identity and capability/state-mode binding
fused_candidate.evidence_law: Each receipt is scoped to its tier/backend/profile/state mode. Lower-tier PASS never promotes to a higher tier; backend equivalence is UNKNOWN until measured.
fused_candidate.authority_law: Twin tooling and profiles are execution/evidence configuration only; UnifiedDB and existing completion/effect authority remain unchanged.

parallel_systemd_lifecycle_research: R6-HOST-SYSTEMD-USER-READINESS-001 is complementary: it defines manager/service lifecycle witness semantics inside a tier. It does not replace tier/backend identity or external functional readback.

next_discriminator.trigger6_e3: Build a deterministic capability/fidelity matrix that proves the fused profile cannot silently collapse nspawn/VM/physical or ephemeral/persistent evidence scopes.
next_discriminator.later_trigger4_e4: Run identical bounded install/restart/update/fault scenarios across Tier A and at least one Tier B backend; measure unique defects, replay determinism, cold start, wall time, CPU/RSS/disk I/O, setup/config surface and blocked-capability causes. Add a second Tier-B backend only if its unique information gain justifies maintenance cost.
